reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V1 (the agent's only improving variant: KS recalibrated + per-segment straight-line bias) by re-implementing v1_ks_recalibrated from skills/yaw-divergence-triage/triage.py with parameters from code/parameters.py, computing the straight-line bias per sim.csv segment and subtracting from KS.
notes: Agent's REPORT scopes V1 to FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 only; canonical pooling applies the same per-segment-bias logic to F-150 Lightning as well, which is consistent with the V1 definition (bias is computed from each segment's own straight-line samples, no fitted parameters to transfer). Bias term uses the agent's straight regime mask (|delta|<0.01) over the full segment, not the v>2 canonical filter, matching the agent's implementation.
